_why: wq#2821: a LiteLLM rung name is not a model identity. On 2026-09-28 the wq#2815 bake-off re-tagged a qwen2.5-coder build as llama3.1:8b on hathor, so the pinned judge rung silently served a different model. bin/judge checks the served weights blob against this file and fails closed on mismatch.
